apps.name: Cosy
apps.subtitle: A tiny cozy top-down world.
apps.versionDescription: Terrain and mobile HUD polish: softer deterministic biome edges, organic shore transitions, clearer spacing, and larger iPhone touch targets.
apps.localizedDescription: Cosy is a small, touch-first top-down game about exploring, gathering resources and slowly building up a cozy world.

versions.localizedDescription: Terrain and mobile HUD polish: softer biome edges, organic shore transitions, and larger iPhone touch targets.
Sprite World: textured terrain, varied world sprites, and the touch-first inventory and marketplace UI.
Inventory + Marketplace UI: a 5-slot hotbar, 5x5 inventory, quantity transfers, withdrawals, deposits, price controls and a polished touch-first HUD.
World + Marketplace slice: explore a scrolling seeded world, gather Wood and Stone, build a Marketplace, set listings and watch NPC Buyers trade for Gold.
First playable Cosy build: move the Purple Dot, pick up the Stick and see it in the inventory, select tools and fell a tree for wood.
